menu_options.group: A group of controllers in the same space

controller.title: Add a Trimlight controller
controller.description: Found {found} controller(s) on the network that aren't set up yet. Pick one, or type a controller's IP address.

group.title: Add a group of controllers
group.description: Controllers in the same space, controlled together as one light. Its patterns are the ones every controller has, matched by name.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach a Trimlight controller at that address.

abort.already_configured: That controller is already set up.

turn_off_in.name: Turn off in
turn_off_in.description: Hands the lights back to their schedule after a number of minutes.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long until they go back to their schedule.

turn_off_at.name: Turn off at
turn_off_at.description: Hands the lights back to their schedule at a time of day (the next time it comes round).

time.name: Time
time.description: When to go back to their schedule.

save_pattern.name: Save pattern
save_pattern.description: Changes the saved pattern with this name, or creates it if there isn't one. Settings left out stay as they are (or take a default on a new pattern). On a group, every controller gets it.

name.name: Name
name.description: The pattern's name (up to 25 plain letters, digits and spaces).

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: 1 to 7 colours, in order: names like red, or codes like #ff0078. Needed for a new pattern.

counts.name: Dots per colour
counts.description: How many dots of each colour in a row, in the same order, e.g. 2, 1, 1. Leave out for 1 each (or as they were).

new_name.name: New name
new_name.description: Up to 25 plain letters, digits and spaces.

delete_pattern.name: Delete pattern
delete_pattern.description: Deletes a saved pattern. This can't be undone.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: The name of the pattern to delete.

copy_pattern.name: Copy pattern
copy_pattern.description: Copies a saved pattern from another Trimlight light to these, over any pattern of the same name.

source.name: From
source.description: The Trimlight light that has the pattern.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: The name of the pattern to copy.

preview_pattern.name: Preview pattern
preview_pattern.description: Shows a pattern on the lights without saving it, to try out settings before saving.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: 1 to 7 colours, in order: names like red, or codes like #ff0078.

counts.name: Dots per colour
counts.description: How many dots of each colour in a row, in the same order.
